root_cause: The merchant is on a blended pricing model paying a fixed 2.0% MDR, which exceeds the underlying true network cost of 1.81%.
diagnosis: A structural fee leakage of Rs 8,366.23 exists because flat rate billing obscures lower actual interchange and network costs across total card volume (using an illustrative/modeled benchmark comparison).
action_rationale: Switching to an Interchange-Plus pricing model directly eliminates the margin markup by pricing transactions at actual cost plus a fixed fee.
